title: Senior Business Analyst - Application Support
description:
TITLE
  
  
Senior Business Analyst - Application Support
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As a Senior Business Analyst within the Application Support team, you will serve as the functional subject matter expert for Duck Creek Reinsurance (DCR). You will own the end-to-end analysis and resolution of complex client issues, translate reinsurance business needs into effective application solutions, and drive continuous improvement in service quality and product performance. Working closely with clients, functional consultants, Product, Engineering, and Cloud Operations, you will act as a trusted advisor, support releases and change initiatives, mentor less-experienced analysts, and help ensure strong customer outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide expert-level functional support for DCR and own complex client issues end-to-end, serving as the primary functional escalation point. Lead impact assessment, prioritization, investigation, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, resolution validation, and closure.
* Elicit and analyze client requirements and translate them into functional specifications, configuration recommendations, defect reports, or enhancement requests aligned with reinsurance business objectives.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, functional consultants, and external partners to resolve issues, manage risk, and ensure timely follow-through.
* Lead or support functional configuration, test planning and execution, release readiness, deployment validation, and post-release stabilization for DCR updates, patches, and enhancements.
* Monitor incident trends, case aging, service-level performance, and application health indicators; implement improvements that strengthen reliability, support efficiency, and the client experience.
* Develop and maintain functional guides, troubleshooting procedures, known-error records, and knowledge articles; lead problem-management reviews for recurring or high-impact issues.
* Build strong client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor by clearly communicating impacts, risks, options, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Lead regular client follow-up meetings to provide assistance, review backlog priorities, and deliver timely updates throughout the full lifecycle of client-reported issues and tickets.
* Coach and mentor less-experienced analysts, review complex cases, and promote consistent support standards and share knowledge across the team.
* Maintain current expertise in DCR functionality, reinsurance industry practices, IT service management, and emerging support technologies.
* Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:
* Mission: To empower insurers/ Reinsurance to reimagine the future of insurance
* Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
* Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Insurance, or a related field with an analytical focus; equivalent relevant experience may be considered
* 3+ years of progressively responsible experience in application support, business analysis, enterprise software, or insurance technology, with demonstrated success owning complex client issues
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional investigation and resolution of production support issues and communicating with client stakeholders
* Working knowledge of reinsurance business processes and enterprise application support practices
* Experience applying incidents, problems, change, and release management practices in a production environment

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Duck Creek Reinsurance (DCR) or a similar reinsurance administration platform.
* Working knowledge of SQL, application logs, monitoring tools, and service management or case-management platforms
* ITIL certification or practical experience with ITIL-based service management.
* Experience with Agile or Scrum methodologies in application support and product environments

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Advanced functional analysis and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex application and business-process issues independently
* Strong knowledge of DCR functionality, configuration concepts, and reinsurance workflows, or the ability to rapidly build deep product expertise
* Proven end-to-end case ownership, prioritization, judgment, and accountability in high-impact client situations
* Strong requirements elicitation, process analysis, and functional documentation skills, with the ability to translate business needs into actionable solutions
* Ability to interpret system behavior, configuration, logs, data, and performance metrics to support root-cause analysis and informed decision-making
* Strong knowledge of incident, problem, change, and release management practices
* Experience with enterprise software testing, user acceptance testing, release cycles, deployment validation, and post-release support
* Ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive issues to timely resolution
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor communication for technical, non-technical, client, and executive stakeholders
* Trusted-advisor mindset with the ability to manage expectations, explain risk, and recommend practical solutions
* Ability to mentor analysts, review case quality, facilitate knowledge transfer, and strengthen team capability
* Strategic and continuous-improvement mindset; ability to use trends and service metrics to identify opportunities and implement improvements
* Strong organization, resilience, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and critical incidents in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency with support tools, case-management systems, application monitoring platforms, and knowledge-management practices
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current on DCR functionality, reinsurance developments, and application support best practices

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
AI STATEMENT
  
  
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
PRIVACY NOTICE
  
  
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data – Refer Privacy Notice
  
  
NOTICE
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept agency resumes.

title: Sr. Analyst - SC Analytics Demand
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The purpose of the job is to support Demand planning function by providing Innovative solutions and help implementing it to optimize/Standardize processes which will bring improvement to overall forecasting approach resulting in better accuracy. Explore and take up opportunities which supports the demand planning efforts by creating and executing industry standard approaches. This role requires you to operate on the 1.30pm to 10.30pm shift.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Basic understanding of new product launches, forecasting techniques, and statistical forecasting models, with the ability to fine-tune model parameters to align forecasts with business needs and market dynamics.
* Analyze forecasting outputs, interpret patterns and trends in complex datasets, and prepare insightful reports to support stakeholder decision-making. Evaluate and monitor key performance metrics, such as forecast accuracy and bias, and publish performance dashboards to keep stakeholders informed.
* Identify improvement opportunities through root cause analysis (RCA) to achieve business targets and enhance reliability, while managing data requirements for new product launch forecasting and prioritizing support requests based on business impact and resource constraints.
* Use tools (like GCP, Python Dash, Tableau, AFO etc.) to extract, transform and manage data from primary and secondary sources using SQL, Excel and Python.
* Collaborate with stakeholders and brand marketing teams to align demand forecasts with launch strategies and promotional plans, lead consensus meetings to incorporate cross-functional feedback, and standardize processes by training stakeholders on tools and methodologies to improve adoption and efficiency.
* Coordinate with technical /data science teams to identify process improvement opportunities, validate outputs, propose modification if required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Operational research, statistics, supply chain and any other relevant field 3 years of related experience
* Experience: 2-3 years of experience in data analysis and high level of analytical skills,
* Technical Skills: Working knowledge of data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Looker, along with forecasting techniques, including time-series models (Exponential Smoothing and ARIMA) and machine learning methods.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis and data handling using R, Python, Excel, and SQL to derive meaningful insights from datasets.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure, as well as supply chain, CPG, and retail operations.
* Soft Skills: Demonstrates critical thinking, integrity, teamwork, demand management expertise, a systematic approach to problem-solving, the ability to influence without authority, and strong interpersonal skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree with a major in Operations or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience.
* Professional certifications such as CSCMP or APICS are preferred.
* Proficiency in Excel, knowledge of ERP systems, and familiarity with functional planning tools such as SAP APO.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Data Modeller
description:
Data Modeller

Mumbai

Please find the details below:

Position Details:

Key Skills: Erwin/ER Studio, Data Analysis, Data Modelling, and Semantic Architecture

Location: Andheri, Mumbai – 5 days onsite

Experience: 8+ years

Job Description – Data Modeller + Data Analyst

Experience: 8–12 years

Role: Data Modeller + Data Analyst

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Data Modeller + Data Analyst who can bridge data

modelling and business analytics. The role will involve approximately 50% data modelling and

50% data analysis, with a strong focus on building scalable data structures, defining semantic

models, developing KPIs, and translating data into actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities

 Design and develop robust conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned

with business requirements.

 Define and maintain data architecture, data structures, relationships, and

business rules.

 Build and manage semantic models to enable consistent and reliable reporting

and analytics.

 Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate

them into analytical solutions.

 Define, develop, and maintain business KPIs and metrics, ensuring consistency

across reporting and analytics.

 Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and business

insights.

 Translate complex datasets into meaningful recommendations and actionable

insights for business teams.

 Collaborate with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Architects, and business

stakeholders to ensure data models support reporting and analytical needs.

 Conduct data profiling, validation, and quality checks to ensure accuracy and

consistency.

 Document data models, KPIs, definitions, and analytical methodologies.

 Support the development and enhancement of BI dashboards and reporting

solutions where required.

Required Skills & Experience

 8–12 years of experience in Data Modelling, Data Analytics, BI, or related data

roles.

 Strong understanding of data modelling concepts and data architecture.

 Hands-on experience with semantic modelling and BI/reporting environments.

 Strong SQL and data analysis capabilities.

 Experience defining and managing KPIs, metrics, and business definitions.

 Ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into data

and analytical solutions.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work eƯectively with both

technical and business stakeholders.

Ideal Candidate Profile

A candidate who is equally comfortable designing the underlying data model and analysing

the data on top of it—someone who can move from “How should the data be structured?” to

“What does the data tell us about the business?”

Apply Now

or WhatsApp it to
**8827565832**

**Job Purpose**
The FP&A Manager is responsible for the preparation, analysis and communication of financial performance across the North Africa region (Morocco, Algeria, Egypt and French West Africa). The role supports monthly management reporting, forecasting, budgeting and business performance management while acting as the key liaison between North Africa, Corporate Finance, Home Office and FSS teams. In a lean finance organization, the role requires a hands-on approach, combining financial analysis, business partnering and stakeholder management to support decision-making and ensure timely reporting. The FP&A Manager is accountable not only for producing the numbers but also for understanding, explaining and communicating the story behind the numbers to Corporate and regional leadership teams.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities - 1**
**Management Reporting & Financial Analysis**

* Prepare monthly management reporting for North Africa, including sales, profitability, gross margin and operating expense analysis.
* Analyze actual performance versus Budget, Forecast and Prior Year, and explain key business drivers and variances.
* Prepare monthly management presentations, executive reviews and ad hoc analyses required by regional and Corporate stakeholders.
* Review key management reporting inputs including sales data, export registers and expense allocations to ensure consistency and accuracy.
* Support management through financial modelling, scenario analyses and performance assessments.

**Key Accountabilities - 2**
**Forecasting, Budgeting & Planning**

* Support the preparation and consolidation of Forecasts, LBEs, Budgets and Strategic Plans across North Africa.
* Work closely with Commercial, Supply Chain and Finance teams to collect, validate and challenge business assumptions.
* Prepare forecast bridges, scenario analyses and business outlook updates for management and Corporate reviews.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of planning deliverables in line with regional and global timelines.
* Maintain a strong understanding of planning assumptions and their impact on business performance.

**Key Accountabilities - 3**
**Business Partnering & Decision Support**

* Partner with Commercial, Supply Chain and Leadership teams to support business performance and decision-making.
* Prepare business cases, profitability assessments and financial analyses for growth, pricing and operational initiatives.
* Monitor business performance and identify areas for improvement in revenue, profitability and operating efficiency.
* Support strategic projects and special assignments as required.

* Review and monitor expenses incurred by business partners in Algeria, Egypt and FWA and ensure supporting documentation is complete and accurate.

* Coordinate and respond to ad hoc requests from Corporate Finance and Home Office teams, including sales submissions, business performance analyses, EBITDA calculations and other management reporting requirements.
* Ensure timely and accurate communication of North Africa financial performance, forecasts and key business updates to Corporate and regional stakeholders.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of regional business performance to effectively explain results, forecasts and budget assumptions during Corporate reviews.

**Key Accountabilities - 5**
**Continuous Improvement & Reporting Tools**

* Maintain reporting files, dashboards and planning models used across the region.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate reporting and planning activities.
* Improve data quality, reporting efficiency and visibility of key business performance indicators.
* Document and continuously improve FP&A processes and ways of working.

A dedicated MIS resource under the E-commerce Control Tower will own the end-to-end reporting stack – ensuring reports are delivered on time, in a consistent format, with a single source of truth for sales, distribution and launch data across all platforms and brands. This will free KAM bandwidth for revenue-generating work and improve the quality and timeliness of data used in weekly and monthly reviews.
  
  

* 3. Key Responsibilities
* 1. Daily Sales Report (DSR) sheet – all platforms
* Frequency: Daily
* Scope / Notes: Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Myntra, Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, Meesho, Purplle.com
* 2. Influencer SKU sheet – all platforms
* Frequency: Daily
* Scope / Notes: SKU-level tracking of influencer-led demand across platforms
* 3. Weekly Deep Dive (WDD) report – all brands
* Frequency: Weekly
* Scope / Notes: Availability and distribution coverage across platforms, cities and dark stores
* 4. WDD-based review presentation
* Frequency: Weekly
* Scope / Notes: Weekly PPT for weekly review with leadership and brand teams
* 5. NPD tracker – status update
* Frequency: Weekly
* Scope / Notes: Listing, live-status and early-sales tracking for new product launches
* 6. Flipkart weekly keyword search-volume tracker
* Frequency: Weekly
* Scope / Notes: Category and brand keyword search-volume trends
* 7. Other trackers – status update
* Frequency: Weekly / as scheduled
* Scope / Notes: All other E-commerce trackers maintained by the team
* 8. Tertiary sales report
* Frequency: Monthly
* Scope / Notes: Platform-wise tertiary (sell-out) consolidation for all brands
* 9. State-wise sales report
* Frequency: Monthly
* Scope / Notes: Geography-level sales cuts for all platforms and brands
* 10. Ad-hoc data requests
* Frequency: As required
* Scope / Notes: Data pulls and analysis for leadership, brand, finance, supply chain and platform KAM teams
* 4. Workload Summary
* Daily: 2 deliverables – DSR and Influencer SKU sheets across 9 platforms
* Weekly: 5 deliverables – WDD report, WDD review PPT, NPD tracker, Flipkart keyword tracker, other trackers
* Monthly: 2 deliverables – Tertiary report and State-wise report
* Ongoing: Ad-hoc data requests from multiple stakeholders

**Education**

* Graduate in any discipline; B.Com / BBA / B.Sc. (Statistics) or MBA preferred

**Experience**

* 1–3 years in an MIS, sales analytics or business reporting role, preferably in FMCG, beauty & personal care or e-commerce
* Prior exposure to marketplace seller panels or brand analytics dashboards (Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto etc.) is a strong advantage

**Skills**

* Advanced MS Excel / Google Sheets – Pivot tables, lookups, Power Query and dashboard building
* High attention to detail and accuracy with large, multi-source data sets
* Ability to manage multiple recurring deadlines and prioritise ad-hoc requests from several stakeholders
* Good written and verbal communication for stakeholder coordination
* Working knowledge of Power BI / SQL is desirable, not mandatory
* 6. Key Stakeholders

**Internal**

* Head of E-commerce
* Senior and Junior KAMs
* Supply Chain Executives
* Brand Managers
* Finance
* Leadership

**Data Sources**

* Platform seller and brand panels
* Internal sales data
* Distributor and warehouse reports
* 7. Budget and Approvals

Compensation band, cost centre and budget availability to be confirmed by HR and Finance as per company policy.
  
  
**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: Senior Risk Reporting Analyst, Wholesale Credit Risk, AVP (Hybrid)
description:
Join Citi's independent Risk Reporting and Exposure Monitoring function and play a pivotal role in shaping how the firm understands, communicates, and manages its wholesale credit risk exposure. As a Senior Risk Reporting Analyst, you will lead the design and delivery of risk frameworks, regulatory submissions, and data-driven reporting that directly informs senior leadership decisions and protects the firm's financial standing. This is a high-impact position within Citi's second line of defence, sitting at the intersection of risk oversight, regulatory compliance, and strategic data management.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Lead the development and implementation of wholesale credit risk management frameworks, ensuring consistent monitoring and mitigation of emerging risks across the portfolio.
* Manage the end-to-end regulatory reporting cycle, ensuring timely and accurate submission of reports in compliance with applicable standards, including FR Y-14.
* Evaluate and validate credit risk models on an ongoing basis, identifying gaps and delivering recommendations that strengthen model integrity and performance.
* Oversee the Corrective Action Plan management programme, tracking identified control deficiencies through to resolution and reporting progress to senior management and regulatory stakeholders.
* Design and implement robust data models and automated reporting processes that enhance the accuracy, consistency, and usability of risk information across the organisation.
* Establish and enforce data quality standards and controls to ensure that risk reporting output is reliable, auditable, and fit for senior and regulatory audiences.
* Contribute to key risk governance committees and forums, facilitating structured discussions and building consensus on risk-related priorities and decisions.
* Advise senior management on risk-related matters, serving as a trusted subject matter expert and proactively identifying opportunities to improve risk controls and operational effectiveness.

****Required Qualifications & Skills****

* 6 to 10 years of experience in risk management, regulatory reporting, or data management within the financial services industry.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL (including query optimization), Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), Tableau, Power BI, and Advanced Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables).
* Hands-on capability in data science and analytics disciplines including machine learning, statistical analysis, propensity modelling, A/B testing, and feature engineering.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain business intelligence outputs such as executive scorecards, KPI dashboards, and portfolio analytics that communicate complex risk information clearly to senior audiences.
* Practical experience in data engineering and automation, including ETL pipeline development, query optimisation, data quality management, and scheduled job automation.
* Familiarity with cloud and analytics platforms including Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, BigQuery), R Studio, IBM SPSS, JIRA, Confluence, and MS Visio.
* Clear and confident communicator across verbal, written, and visual formats, with the ability to present complex risk findings to senior stakeholders and regulatory bodies.

****Beneficial Skills & Qualifications****

* Professional certification in a relevant discipline such as FRM, CFA, or CPA.
* Working knowledge of market risk measures including sensitivities, Value at Risk, and stress testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with wholesale credit risk systems and platforms used within large financial institutions.
* Experience contributing to or leading risk management projects in a debt markets or wholesale banking environment.

description:

The ideal candidate must have strong analytical skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to present technical content in clear and accessible formats. You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities under tight timelines and contributing to evidence-based decision-making.

What will You Do in this role (Roles and Responsibilities)

* Lead the design and strengthening of impact measurement frameworks, indicators, methodologies, analytical approaches, data recording tools, protocols and procedures across programmes.
* Apply statistical and quantitative methods to assess programme effectiveness, outcomes and impact, moving beyond routine monitoring and reporting.
* Generate actionable insights from programme data and translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for programme and leadership teams.

* Advanced data analyses to provide information on achievements against targets, data trends and others, which will help in decision-making for programs.
* Engage with key stakeholders, including donors, partners, and program teams, to support project objectives and address operational challenges. Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective coordination, communication, and successful project implementation.
* Work closely with programme teams to embed learning, evidence and adaptive management into programme design and implementation.
* Ensure timely submission of data requirements and narrative summary reports for donor reporting.
* Plan and execute various evaluation/research projects to provide inputs for program implementation strategy and to showcase program impact.
* Monitoring visits to health system strengthening program sites every quarter.
* Co-ordinate with program staff in case of errors, data entry issues, application update, and technical support.
* Conducting training on applications, addressing issues faced by staff and other users, and providing support.
* Any other task assigned by the supervisor from time to time. MEL role will involve working in all other programs.

**We are looking for someone who has:**

* Postgraduate degree in Statistics/ Biostatistics, Mathematics, Public Health (MPH), or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 5 -7 years of professional experience in public health programs, with demonstrated expertise in data analysis, monitoring and evaluation, and reporting.
* Experience of working with not-for-profit organisation working in Public Health domain will be a plus.
* Proven experience in donor management, including regular engagement with donors, ensuring timely fulfilment of donor requirements, reporting, assessments, and compliance standards.

**Skills and Competencies:**

**Non negotiable**

* Proven ability to translate complex health data and program findings into clear, actionable reports and visual formats (Ability to design and execute impact measurement).
* Proven experience in writing technical reports, and stakeholder documentation.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative data analysis skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Morgan Stanley is building out an industry-leading deposits and cash management offering, that capitalizes on the acquisitions of E\*TRADE and Shareworks. title: Asset and Liability Management (ALM) Specialist - AVP
description:
**Position Overview**
**In Scope of Position based Promotions**
**Job Title: Asset and Liability Management (ALM) Specialist**
**Corporate Title**
**: Associate / AVP**
**Location: Mumbai, India**
**Treasury**

* Treasury at Deutsche Bank is responsible for sourcing, managing, and optimizing Deutsche Bank's financial resources and providing high-quality steering to the Bank on financial resource deployment.
* Treasury's fiduciary mandate encompasses the Bank's funding pools, asset and liability management (ALM), liquidity reserves management, and supporting businesses in delivering their strategic targets at the global and local levels. Further, Treasury manages all financial resource optimization to implement the group's strategic objective and maximize long-term return on average tangible shareholders' equity (RoTE).
* The current role is part of the Treasury Office in Mumbai. The position requires interactions with all key hubs i.e., London, New York, Frankfurt, and Singapore.

**Function Description:**

* The Asset & Liability Management (ALM) team inside of Treasury is responsible for Structural risk management for the firm, including Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB).
* The recent movement in Interest Rates has made IRRBB a key focus of top management and investors. Within the CFO organization, management of IRRBB is considered to be a top priority for the Bank.

**Role Description**

* The candidate will be part of the Asset & Liability Management (ALM) function responsible for managing the interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB). The team develops, parameterizes, and implements quantitative models to measure risk.
* The results are used for risk management decisions and regular internal and external reporting. The team acts as an intermediary in treasury itself and between the business units and other central functions like Market Risk Management. This gives you a unique view into many exciting, complex and important risk management topics.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
  
  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor IRRBB metrics of Delta NII & Delta EVE under different model parameters and scenarios, including responsibility for timely production of Delta NII metrics for Group-Wide Stress Testing (GWST) scenarios.
* Perform risk analysis and prepare reports and presentations for senior management.
* Perform back-testing of Delta NII model outputs against actual results to identify potential deficiencies in model assumptions, methodology, or underlying data quality.
* Support the preparation of audit memos and related documentation required to facilitate closure of internal audit findings related to IRRBB processes, models, and data.
* Collaborate closely with the Risk in Banking Book (RIBB) team to ensure accurate and complete data capture enabling robust and reliable IRRBB metrics production
* Develop and enhance Tableau dashboards to enable granular analysis and monitoring of IRRBB exposures and trends.
* Assist in daily and monthly production/analysis of delta EVE and RNI (Risk Not In) reports.
* Support model governance activities, including model documentation, model risk assessments and remediation of model validation findings.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* University degree with a quantitative focus such as Engineering, Finance, Mathematics or Computer Science
* Good knowledge in data analysis and processing using Python
* At least two years of relevant experience in Asset Liability Management, Risk Management or Treasury functions
* Demonstrated expertise in creating compelling presentations and developing interactive dashboards using Tableau or similar visualization tools
* Strong written, verbal communication and presentation skills
* Distinctive analytical and problem-solving abilities and a tech-savvy mind set

**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.

**About Us And Our Teams**
Please visit our company website for further information:
  
  
**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
  
  
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
  
  
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Demand Planning SME - o9 IBP & SOE
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.**
You will develop the 0-24-month IBP forecast by brand and at the stock keeping unit (SKU) level. You will coordinate, challenge and influence building block with input from sales, marketing and other partners. In addition, you will review the disaggregated short-term demand plan, which includes SKU/location mix and weekly pacing. Finally, you will provide the finalized detailed demand plan by SKU to supply planners and adjust it based on feedback from supply planners or commercial teams.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
You will:
  
  

* Contribute to the demand management cycle of the integrated business planning (IBP) process for your categories and to strategy and structure discussions
* Liaise with the commercial and operational teams and develop ways to continuously improve communication between the functions to support the delivery of the business KPIs for their families
* Manage forecast compilation process, which includes owning the short-term weekly plan and the long-term forecast (three or more months)
* Interact with modelling team to generate statistical forecasting
* Participate in the integrated business planning process and manage the demand planning tool
* Perform root-cause analysis for continuous plan improvement for key service issues, forecast error and bias, and share output with appropriate leadership

**What You Will Bring**
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
  
  

* Experience in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment, preferably in food or other fast moving, dynamic industry where shelf life is a constraint
* Experience within an IBP/S&OP environment
* Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on priorities and improving the plan
* Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills – and able to understand and interpret data
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Team player who can work with many other functions on a daily basis

**More About This Role**
**What you need to know about this position:**
You will be an integral part of the implementation and go-live of the new planning solution (o9) within the AMEA region, with a primary focus on executing Integration Testing (I Test), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data validation, and end-user training. You will work closely with the BU Champion and regional SME leads to ensure the solution is thoroughly tested, validated, and ready for business adoption. Meanwhile, as an early foundation of demand analysis role, this role would require business insights to deep dive into forecast error reasons and improve the AIML/Operation fcst KPI with BU team.
  
  
**What extra ingredients you will bring:**

* Solid understanding of Demand Planning processes (statistical forecasting, consensus planning, demand sensing)
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Planning or a related operational role
* Familiarity with planning tools/systems; exposure to advanced planning solutions (o9, Kinaxis, OMP, SAP IBP) is a necessity.
* Strong attention to detail — ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies
* Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects
* Good communication skills — ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner
* Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines
* Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment
* Proficiency in English; additional regional language skills are a plus

**Education / Certifications:**
Bachelor's Degree or postgraduate. With relevant Demand planning experience.
  
  
**Job specific requirements:**
The Demand Planning SME will serve as the BU's dedicated testing and adoption resource for the o9 Demand Planning module. Reporting into the region DP transformation lead, this role is responsible for executing test scripts, validating data integrity, supporting training delivery, and ensuring seamless transition from testing to go-live. The SME will act as the first line of support for end users, bridging the gap between the technical implementation team and the business, and championing user confidence and adoption of the new platform.
  
  
**Testing & Validation**

* Execute Integration Test (iTest) and UAT test scripts end-to-end for Demand Planning processes, ensuring 100% script coverage as per the test strategy
* Validate pre-load and post-load data accuracy during User Cutover Testing (UCUT), flagging discrepancies and coordinating resolution with the data and cutover teams
* Perform security role validation — test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase
* Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases
* Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP
* Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks
* Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates

**Training & Change Adoption**

* Support the delivery of Pre-UAT and UAT training sessions for BU end users, including o9 system basics, Day-in-the-Life (DILO) walkthroughs, and advanced DP system training
* Conduct shadow testing sessions — walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence
* Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working
* Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance
* Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts

**Go-Live & Sustainment**

* Support Parallel Run execution — assist end users in running DILO/MILO cycles using real business cases to validate outcomes
* Participate in BU Readiness Checkpoints and contribute to UAT sign-off documentation
* Provide hypercare support post go-live, acting as the first point of contact for end-user queries and issues
* Document lessons learned, process gaps, and improvement opportunities from testing phases to feed into sustainment planning
* Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform

**Demand Analysis Support**

* High data quality management before modelling run – co-work with market planner and stakeholder to set foundation of master data, transaction and driver data.
* Closely working with data scientists to maintain the highest degree of forecast at item and planning accounts level based on industry trends and demand patterns.
* Conduct forecast review and analysis to assess demand trends, measure forecast accuracy, recommend data-driven adjustments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product lifecycle milestones, ensuring accurate demand planning for new items.
* Propose and implement forecasting improvements to enhance demand accuracy and efficiency.
* Partner with market planners to review KPIs, gather market insights, and translating market insights into actionable forecast adjustments.
* Monitor and ensure KPI metrics consistently meet business goals.
* Provide weekly performance recaps, including ASE performance reviews, root cause analysis, and action plans aligned with business operations.

No Relocation support available
  
  
**Business Unit Summary**
Headquartered in Singapore, Mondelēz International’s Asia, Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is comprised of six business units, has more than 21,000 employees and operates in more than 27 countries including Australia, China, Indonesia, Ghana, India, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Thailand, United Arab Emirates and Vietnam. Seventy-six nationalities work across a network of more than 35 manufacturing plants, three global research and development technical centers and in offices stretching from Auckland, New Zealand to Casablanca, Morocco. biscuits,

cheese. We are also proud to be named a Top Employer in many of our markets.
  
  
Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Risk Model Validation, Officer (Hybrid)
description:
As a Risk Model Validation Officer, you will independently assess and challenge credit, market, and operational risk models to strengthen Citi's risk management framework. You will perform model validations, annual reviews, and ongoing monitoring for assigned model and product types, working closely with a Validation Lead to ensure models meet rigorous performance and governance standards. This role gives you direct influence over how Citi measures and manages financial risk across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform model validations, annual model reviews, and ongoing monitoring reviews for low and medium risk-rated models within your assigned product area.
* Challenge model development approaches and assumptions to confirm models meet Citi's model risk management standards.
* Track model limitation remediation progress and verify that corrective actions are properly implemented.
* Evaluate the ongoing performance of validated models to confirm they continue to perform as intended.
* Contribute analysis and documentation to support regulatory exams and internal audit reviews.
* Prepare validation reports and materials for review by senior model risk management stakeholders.
* Help shape validation standards, templates, and best-practice documentation used across the model validation function.

title: Market Risk Associate - CIO
description:
**Job Description**
As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorganChase strong and resilient by helping the firm grow its business in a responsible way through anticipating new and emerging risks and using expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers, and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo, and striving to be best-in-class. Chief Investment Office, Treasury and Corporate Risk manages the risk of the retained portfolio generated from the Chief Investment Office, Global Treasury, and other Corporate businesses (Firm-wide Pension Plan, Insurance programs, and Mortgage Servicing Rights). As a Market Risk Associate in the Chief Investment Office and Corporate Treasury business team, you will support Portfolio Managers to facilitate efficient risk/return decisions, reduce volatility in operating performance, and ensure the business market risk profile is transparent to senior management, the Board of Directors, and regulators.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a Market Risk Associate within the Chief Investment Office and Corporate Treasury business team, you will support Portfolio Managers to facilitate efficient risk/return decisions and reduce volatility in operating performance. You will help ensure the business market risk profile is transparent to senior management, the Board of Directors, and regulators. You will focus on fixed income markets and the corresponding retained portfolios managed within Chief Investment Office, Treasury and Corporate Risk, producing analytics and research-driven insights to inform investment and risk decisions.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Develop expertise in fixed income markets and Chief Investment Office, Treasury and Corporate Risk corresponding portfolios; produce bespoke analytics and apply research topics to the investment portfolio, pre-trade investment reviews, and limit updates
* Highlight and discuss risk changes and top risks; present deep dives to Chief Investment Office, Treasury and Corporate Risk colleagues and senior risk management
* Monitor market risk positions daily with the aim to identify material risk exposures and concentrations
* Synthesize top-of-mind research topics relevant to the investment portfolios into analysis and special reports
* Analyze macroeconomic variables and understand the impact to financial projections
* Evaluate and implement updates to financial models used in market risk management, including challenging proposed methodology, performing impact assessments, and coordinating model implementation timelines
* Drive efficiencies and process improvements and support technology initiatives
* Improve risk transparency, methodologies, and reports by collaborating with quantitative teams on model results and implementation, such as Quantitative Research and the Model Review Group
* Contribute to Chief Investment Office, Treasury and Corporate Risk standards and best practices by collaborating with other risk groups; represent Chief Investment Office, Treasury and Corporate Market Risk in related initiatives and ensure timely delivery of projects
* Respond to urgent ad-hoc requests from senior risk management

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* 2+ years of experience in risk management and/or fixed income / securitized products
* Understanding of fixed income markets with a particular focus on securitization products (CLOs, CMBS, ABS, RMBS)
* Understanding of the governance and controls surrounding risk monitoring including value at risk (VaR), stress testing, various return measures, and experience with stress construction
* Excellent written and spoken communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts in practical terms; must be able to converse with a wide variety of groups
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively and independently across different businesses and functional areas with thorough attention to detail in a high-pressure environment
* Ability to challenge the portfolio manager's market positions and views and help assess the best allocation of risk and capital to various positions and businesses
* Self-motivated, diligent, strong sense of accountability and good at following up on issues
* Strong technical skills in Excel, VBA, and Bloomberg; ability to learn how to use core business and risk systems
* Excellent academic record and an undergraduate degree are required

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Advanced degree in finance or a related quantitative field
* MBA from a top tier school
* Professional qualification in CFA or Accountancy

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. title: Research Analyst
description:
**About the Role**

Our client is a leading multinational organization engaged in global commodity trading and international commerce, with an established presence across multiple markets and geographies. Its business focuses on the physical movement and trading of commodities, connecting producers, suppliers and end-users across international supply chains.

The organization is seeking a commercially minded
**Research Analyst – Trading Desk Support**
to support its physical trading business through in-depth market research, fundamental analysis and data-driven insights. The role will focus on understanding global commodity market dynamics, tracking physical supply-demand fundamentals and evaluating price movements, trade flows and commercial opportunities to support informed trading decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Market Research & Intelligence:**
  Analyze global commodity markets, including production, consumption, inventory levels, supply-demand balances and international physical trade flows.
* **Market Monitoring:**
  Track macroeconomic developments, geopolitical events, government policies, regulatory changes, freight rates and other factors affecting physical commodity availability, pricing and trade economics.
* **Price Analysis & Forecasting:**
  Assess historical and current price trends, regional price differentials, market spreads, basis movements and arbitrage opportunities relevant to physical commodity trading.
* **Reporting & Insights:**
  Prepare daily, weekly and monthly market updates, research reports, dashboards and presentations highlighting market developments, emerging risks and potential trading opportunities.
* **Analytical Modelling:**
  Build and maintain commodity market models, databases and analytical tools to evaluate supply-demand scenarios, forecast price movements and assess physical trading economics.
* **Trading Desk Support:**
  Work closely with physical traders and commercial teams to provide market intelligence and analytical inputs for sourcing, procurement, sales and trading decisions, including pre-trade assessments and post-trade performance reviews.
* **Trade Flow & Commercial Analysis:**
  Evaluate regional supply-demand imbalances, import-export patterns, logistics constraints, freight costs and destination-market dynamics to identify potential sourcing and trading opportunities.
* **External Market Intelligence:**
  Use industry publications, market data platforms, research reports and relevant industry contacts to strengthen market understanding and develop independent views on commodity markets.
* **Strategic Market Outlook:**
  Contribute to medium- and long-term commodity outlooks, scenario analysis and strategic assessments to support the organization's physical trading activities and business planning.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification in a relevant field would be an advantage.
* 3–7 years of relevant experience in commodity research, market intelligence, physical commodity trading, trading analytics or related commercial research.
* Good understanding of physical commodity markets, international trade flows, supply-demand fundamentals and the factors influencing commodity prices.
* Experience in fundamental research, commodity balance analysis, price forecasting and market modelling.
* Familiarity with regional price differentials, spreads, basis analysis, arbitrage concepts and hedging principles in the context of physical trading.
* Understanding of international sourcing, procurement, logistics, freight economics and import-export dynamics would be beneficial.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel and data analysis; experience with Power BI, Python or other analytical tools would be an advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convert market information into actionable commercial insights.

title: Senior Research Specialist, Oil
description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR A NEW TEAM MEMBER! Join our diverse, globally distributed team.
  
  
The LSEG Oil Research team is providing market insight, analysis and instantaneous access to clients interested in the crude oil and refined products markets by continuously monitoring and providing analysis on global supply and demand, trade flows, infrastructure outages, derivatives market and other financial activities.
  
  
**The analyst will have responsibility to develop and maintain Python-based models of crude and refined product supply and demand balances and price forecasts. The role is based in Mumbai with a focus on the Asian markets, though knowledge of market dynamics across other regions or at the global level is desirable.**
The new joiner will also be involved in data collection and manipulation, quantitative and qualitative analysis, and assist in writing and publishing timely weekly and adhoc special reports. The candidate will also be required to develop PowerBI models and dashboards for distribution of model outputs, along with PowerPoint documents based on our research and datasets, and ultimately work with the senior analysts on building relationships with the various partners in the energy market.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic Research team to develop new methodologies, quantitative models and analysis that directly create client impact!
  
  
**Role Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for conducting primary and secondary research mainly on Crude Oil markets, with a focus on building supply & demand models.
* The analyst is encouraged to come with a strong analytics and modelling background either as part of a Research advisory organization or for an oil company.
* Maintain daily interaction with a network of local and international oil market players to provide market insight for our clients.
* Conduct research, prepare client-facing materials, and complete workflow to the required quality and within the designated timeframe.
* Continuously maintain and improve core technical and analytical processes.
* Support the business development process by preparing client presentations to showcase our capabilities and research to clients.

**Qualifications and Experience Required:**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Economics, Mathematics/Statistics, Engineering or Petroleum studies from a reputable university.
* A masters or technical specialization / certification would be advantageous
* Experience of at least 3-5 years in the physical oil markets or a research house, with an understanding of market fundamentals and the oil value chain.
* Proficiency of Python to query, interrogate and build models using large data sets. Knowledge of machine learning techniques desirable.
* Advanced skills in using the Microsoft suite of applications and visualization tools such as Power BI (or) Tableau. Some understanding of financial markets, and their impact on the oil industry would be an advantage.
* Able to conduct, analyze, and report primary research.
* Ability to communicate market insights in clear and concise style through reports, presentations, and webinars.
* Good critical thinking, problem-solving and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Able to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, while completing work to required standard within the allocated timeframes.

As a global business, LSEG relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. Therefore we seek hardworking, qualified employees in all our operations around the world, regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, sex/gender (including pregnancy, gender identity and expression), sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under country or local law. LSEG is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer, offering paid leave and health and wellness benefits, in addition to other benefits.

Senior Associate
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

description:

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the Business to provide a comprehensive view.
  
  
As an associate in the Wholesale Credit Risk Forecasting Team, candidate will focus on execution and framework testing, delivering credit risk modeling and credit risk strategic innovation for the technology platforms to meet the requirements of CCAR/Stress Testing, Credit Stress Framework, and Economic Credit Capital. You will play a key role in monthly/quarterly model preparation and execution, as well as collaborate closely with developers, modelers and technology to design and implement strategic enhancements to wholesale credit projects including technology platforms, operating model, data pipeline, and analytics framework. Additionally, you'll coordinate model library updates, assess the impact of model and implementation changes on forecast outputs and clearly translate those implications to Analytics and other stakeholders.

* Execute and deliver the quarterly stress and allowance SDLC testing across all execution workstreams

* Help to plan and perform for all production/testing needs

* Perform control and reconciliation against deliveries in addition to creating/enhancing formal governance
* Perform portfolio analysis, data segmentation, data transformation and database interaction to prepare various datasets

* BA/BS degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, data analytics, economics
* Minimum 3+ years of experience working in a finance organization with data analytics and/or credit risk, Wholesale Risk Management, Quantitative Research, Data Analytics, Model Testing
* Technologically savvy with an ability to understand systems and their internal functionality; Coding knowledge and experience in Python/SQL is required
* Ability to organize work and solve problems independently and excel in a deadline-oriented environment
* Strong communications skills, written and verbal – significant interaction with LOBs, risk streams, senior managers, and external stakeholders

title: Manager, Strategy & Operations
description:
SLSQ227R598
  
  
Databricks is looking for a motivated Sr. Manager, Strategy & Operations to join our Field Engineering team that helps define Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, provides strategic analyses and instills operational thoughtfulness to our successful & fast-growing GTM business.
  
  
You will use data and qualitative information to help our Sales and Field Engineering Leadership manage the business. You will support essential aspects of our GTM design and annual planning process. This is an individual contributor role. You will help build our data and analytics foundation including executive reporting, health of business reviews, dashboards, and Indicators. You will work with our Field Engineering, Sales, Finance, Data, Marketing, Order Ops, and other GTM teams. You will report to the Sr. Director, Strategy and Ops.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**

* Establish the GTM Strategy and build processes in place to ensure we have the right investments at the right time
* Be a trusted partner to the GTM Leadership by defining, tracking, and implementing goals, programs and strategies that scale
* Guide annual GTM planning process (FY and long-range modeling, investment Return on investment analysis, HC planning, capacity setting)
* Design and manage the headcount forecasting process (FY, long-range, and quarterly modeling)
* Lead executive analyses, strategies, and deliverables (e.g., board materials, QBR)
* Provide visibility and performance tracking to the business (Operational councils, Ops reviews, rep. efficiency and productivity Indicators, dashboards)
* Help build our data and reporting foundation
* Improve operational efficiency by automating and improving processes, and dashboards that scale

**What We Look For**

* 7+ years of strategy & operations experience (Investment banking, strategy consulting, FP&A, business operations, Enterprise/Mid-Market SaaS experience)
* Ability and passion to analyze, set priorities, and solve complex problems
* Propensity to summarize complex concepts and data and present clear information to executives, teams, and internal customers
* Data expert: Querying and scoping (SQL, Databricks, BigQuery), analysis (Excel), summarizing (pivot tables, charts, slides, written explanation), reporting (dashboards, repositories)
* Process expert: Envision E2E process change to solve our needs, drive agreement, document requirements, guide execution in partnership with IT, perform UAT, and report on progress
* Proficient in BI and sales tools (eg: Salesforce, Tableau etc.)
* Passion for building and working in a high performance global team
* A fondness for customer service and patience

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. title: BA4 - Research Operations
description:
Join us as a “BA4 - Research”, where you will provide subject matter expertise on India employment legislation, Regulatory Requirements, and Organizational compliance procedures. In this role, you will support the organization by offering guidance on complex employment law matters, interpreting statutory requirements, ensuring that policies and processes reflect current legal standards and attend various hearings with the regulators . You will partner with various stakeholders to drive fair, consistent, and legally compliant employee practices across the organization.
  
  
To be successful as a “BA4 - Research”, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Overall Purpose Of Role**
The role involves managing the process for capturing and standardizing broker votes.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with Research business managers to capture broker vote data from various client formats in a pre-defined structure and format using a web-based portal.
  
  
This successful candidate will own this process across the Americas and European client base and will engage with multiple stakeholders to ensure capture is completed in a timely fashion on an ongoing basis.
  
  
The candidate will also drive delivery of key reports and help provide valuable business/monetization analysis for multiple stakeholders in research.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Assisting with broker vote processing – taking ownership for managing the centralized processing for Broker votes, including analyzing broker vote data, standardizing it, capturing information, coordinating with sales, working on any ad-hoc request related to broker vote.
* Supporting Research Sales and Client Strategy with key insights on votes and client consumption.
* Responsibility to ensure accuracy of data in the portal as per predefined agreement per client.
* Delivering/Maintaining interactive tools and dashboards by using Business Objects and MS Excel.

**Stakeholder Management And Leadership**
As part of a global team, the Mumbai based individual will be directly required to interact and work with different stakeholders in Research various regions and time zones. The individual will require exceptionally strong written and oral communication and presentation skills.
  
  
**Decision-making And Problem Solving**
This role requires the candidate to have excellent analytical skills. The candidate will be required to have in-depth knowledge of votes and be able to make decisions to standardize information as well as resolve queries from team members in this regard.

Ensure that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, Enterprise-Wide Risk Management Framework and internal Barclays Policies and Policy Standards.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work in a time sensitive environment.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Strong interest in the subject matter.
* Resourcefulness, and proactive attitude.
* Proficient in MS Excel using Macros and MS Office applications with the knowledge of lookups, functions and basic reporting in Excel.

**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**

* Ability to quickly grasp concepts and implement them.
* Report development using SAP Business Objects is preferable.
* Basic understanding of financial terms and the research business would be an added advantage.

Location-Mumbai.

title: Data Governance Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a detail-oriented
**Data Governance Analyst**
to lead data quality and data integrity auditing activities across the enterprise. This role will be responsible for designing, executing, maintaining, and continuously improving data quality audits to ensure critical data assets remain accurate, complete, consistent, and compliant with established governance standards.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of master data, transactional data, reference data, and enterprise data ecosystems, along with the analytical skills required to identify trends, uncover risks, and communicate actionable insights to business stakeholders and data stewards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own, execute, and maintain enterprise data quality and data integrity audits across key data domains.
* Partner with Data Governance Leads and business stakeholders to identify data risks, define controls, and enhance audit methodologies.
* Continuously refine audit rules, thresholds, and monitoring criteria based on evolving business requirements and governance standards.
* Analyze audit results to identify trends, root causes, and emerging data quality risks.
* Develop meaningful metrics, scorecards, dashboards, and executive summaries to communicate findings.
* Present insights and recommendations to data stewards, data owners, and governance forums.
* Track remediation efforts and validate resolution of identified data quality issues.
* Support the implementation of data governance policies, standards, and controls.
* Collaborate with business and technology teams to improve data quality processes and prevent recurring issues.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3-6 years of experience in Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Analytics, Master Data Management, or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of:

+ Master Data
+ Transactional Data
+ Reference Data
+ Data Quality Management
+ Data Governance principles and controls

* Knowledge of distribution business processes and the challenges associated with multi-system data environments.
* Understanding of Single Source of Truth (SSOT) concepts and enterprise data lifecycle management.
* Experience using BigQuery or similar data platforms and querying tools (SQL required).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify meaningful insights.
* Experience creating reports, dashboards, and presentations for business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Strong attention to detail and investigative mindset.
* Ability to translate complex data findings into clear business recommendations.
* Comfortable working across business and technology teams.
* Passion for data quality, governance, and continuous process improvement.
