title: Data Analyst, Finance Technology
description:
*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*
**Job Description**
PRIMARY FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
**Business process and data understanding**

* Develop a detailed understanding of how Fund Accounting data is created, enriched, transformed, reviewed, reconciled, approved, and consumed.
* Work with Fund Accounting, Data Governance, and Data Product Management to define business problems, intended outcomes, priorities, users, business rules, data ownership, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify sources of truth, data owners, business definitions, transformation points, downstream consumers, dependencies, controls, and process handoffs.
* Analyze current-state processes and data flows to identify manual work, duplicate logic, data issues, control gaps, and standardization opportunities.

**Requirements And Business Rules**

* Translate Fund Accounting needs into clear business, data, integration, reporting, and broader consumption requirements for the appropriate delivery teams.
* Define field definitions, measures, calculations, dimensions, filters, hierarchies, business rules, mappings, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes.
* Partner with Data Governance and Data Product Management on data ownership, definitions, quality expectations, lineage, control requirements, prioritization, and decision records.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, process flows, requirements, and traceability artifacts in collaboration with the teams responsible for implementation.
* Frame requirements clearly enough for the Finance Technology Data Solutions Engineer, Enterprise Data Engineering, Centralized Reporting / BI, and application teams to design, build, test, and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.

**Data investigation, reconciliation, and testing**

* Use SQL and structured analysis to profile data, compare sources, identify anomalies, trace records, quantify breaks, and support root-cause analysis.
* Perform field-level and aggregate analysis to distinguish source, transformation, reference-data, integration, and reporting issues.
* Partner with Fund Accounting, Data Governance, Data Product Management, engineering, and reporting teams to define validation rules, tolerances, exception categories, ownership, and remediation expectations.
* Develop and execute reconciliation, integration, regression, edge-case, reporting, and production-validation test scenarios as part of the broader delivery team.
* Create repeatable queries and validation packs that can be reused by the broader team.

**Reporting And Broader Data Consumption Requirements**

* Understand the business question, intended consumers, decisions supported, frequency, level of detail, and delivery channel for each consumption need.
* Define requirements for dashboards, reports, extracts, downstream applications, operational workflows, analytics, and other ways Fund Accounting consumes data and derives value from it.
* Identify governed sources of truth and document measures, calculations, dimensions, filters, business rules, refresh expectations, control expectations, reconciliation needs, and validation criteria.
* Convey agreed business requirements to Centralized Reporting / BI, which owns the technical build and delivery of scalable dashboards and reporting solutions using governed data.
* Coordinate Fund Accounting review, business validation, UAT, release readiness, and post-production validation for reporting and other consumption solutions.

**Delivery and stakeholder partnership**

* Act as the bridge between Fund Accounting business teams and Finance Technology while preserving important business and technical detail.
* Coordinate with Data Product Management, Data Governance, the Finance Technology Data Solutions Engineer, Enterprise Data Engineering, Centralized Reporting / BI, application teams, and delivery partners throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Maintain traceability from the original business problem through requirements, design, testing, release, and validation of the delivered outcome.
* Communicate issues clearly, including affected users and data, business impact, evidence, decisions needed, and recommended next steps.
* Help convert recurring manual investigation into prioritized backlog items and governed, reusable, scalable data or consumption solutions.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related discipline. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  
  
**Experience Required:**
3 to 8 years in a technical data analyst, data-focused business analyst, financial data, accounting technology, or similar role in a controlled enterprise environment.
  
  
**Must-have Capabilities**

* Strong SQL for profiling, joins, aggregations, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis, preferably in SQL Server.
* Advanced Excel for structured analysis, including lookups, pivots, formulas, comparisons, and controlled validation workbooks.
* Experience defining business, data, reporting, and consumption requirements; mappings; measures; calculations; business rules; acceptance criteria; and test cases.
* Hands-on data-quality analysis, reconciliation, defect investigation, testing, business validation, and UAT.
* Ability to understand data models, ETL/ELT flows, APIs or file interfaces, reporting layers, and dependencies across source, data, and consumption layers.
* Ability to work effectively with Fund Accounting, Data Product Management, Data Governance, Finance Technology engineering, Enterprise Data Engineering, Centralized Reporting / BI, and application teams.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Databricks, Python, PySpark, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, or similar platforms.
* Fund Accounting, asset management, investor data, fund administrator, financial reporting, or investment operations experience.
* Working knowledge of accounting balances, transactions, capital activity, reference data, hierarchies, controls, and period-end processes.
* Experience defining requirements for dashboards, reports, extracts, downstream applications, operational workflows, or analytics.
* Exposure to delivery tooling, structured defect triage, release management, lineage, metadata, governance, and auditability concepts.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Business, data, reporting, and consumption requirements are clear, complete, testable, and aligned to business objectives.

title: VisionPlus Technical Business Analyst
description:

Synechron is seeking a
**Business Analyst – Technical (VisionPLUS)**
for its Mumbai, work-from-office team. The role requires 7
**+ years of Business Analyst experience**
, with hands-on expertise in VisionPLUS applications and a strong understanding of the cards and payments domain. The successful candidate will gather and translate business requirements into functional solutions, support VisionPLUS and related payment systems, and coordinate delivery across business, development, testing, UAT, and production support teams. This role contributes to business objectives by enabling accurate requirements, effective system enhancements, reliable integrations, and timely delivery of payment-related solutions.
  
  
**Required**
**Software Requirements (Required and Preferred)**

* VisionPLUS: Hands-on experience with CMS, FAS, TRAMS, VMX, or related VisionPLUS modules; experience with the version currently implemented within the assigned environment.
* SQL: Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, investigation, and requirements support.
* Business Analysis and Documentation Tools: Experience preparing BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability records.
* Defect and Test Management Tools: Experience coordinating UAT, recording and tracking defects, validating fixes, and supporting test execution.
* SDLC and Agile Delivery Tools: Experience working with tools and processes for requirements management, sprint planning, backlog tracking, delivery coordination, and status reporting.
* Data Analysis Tools: Ability to use approved query, reporting, spreadsheet, or data analysis tools to investigate business and system information.

**Preferred**

* API Integration Tools: Exposure to API documentation, request and response analysis, integration testing, and payment system interfaces.
* Digital Payment Platforms: Experience analyzing requirements related to digital payments or related payment channels.
* Process Modeling Tools: Experience creating process flows, functional diagrams, data flows, or system interaction diagrams.
* Banking and Financial Services Applications: Experience supporting banking, cards, payments, or financial services systems.
* Collaboration and Knowledge Management Tools: Experience using tools for stakeholder communication, documentation, meeting records, and delivery coordination.

**Overall Responsibilities**

* Gather, analyze, validate, and document business and functional requirements for VisionPLUS applications and related payment systems.
* Work with business stakeholders, development teams, testing teams, and other delivery participants to clarify requirements and resolve functional questions.
* Analyze VisionPLUS applications and relevant modules, including CMS, FAS, TRAMS, VMX, or related components, to support enhancements, integrations, and system upgrades.
* Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and requirements traceability documentation.

* Translate business needs into clear, testable, and implementation-ready functional requirements.
* Support solution discussions by explaining business processes, data requirements, system behavior, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Coordinate UAT activities, including test planning support, scenario preparation, stakeholder coordination, defect triage, retesting, and sign-off tracking.
* Support defect management by analyzing reported issues, clarifying expected behavior, coordinating with technical teams, and validating resolutions.
* Provide functional support for production incidents and assist with impact analysis, root-cause investigation, communication, and resolution validation.

* Maintain accurate documentation and consider efficient use of systems, data, and processing resources when defining or improving solutions.

* Minimum 7 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a comparable technical business analysis role.
* Hands-on experience with VisionPLUS, including CMS, FAS, TRAMS, VMX, or related modules.
* Strong experience in the credit card and payments domain, including relevant business processes, system functionality, and payment-related data.
* Demonstrated experience gathering requirements, conducting gap analysis, preparing functional documentation, and managing stakeholder expectations.
* Experience working with development and testing teams to clarify requirements, support solution delivery, coordinate UAT, and manage defects.
* Experience supporting VisionPLUS applications and related payment systems through enhancements, integrations, system upgrades, and production support.
* Working knowledge of SQL, data analysis, SDLC, and Agile methodologies.
* Experience working with banking or financial services clients is preferred.
* Exposure to API integrations and digital payment platforms is preferred.
* Candidates may qualify through equivalent experience in technical business analysis, cards and payments systems, VisionPLUS support, or related financial services technology roles where they can demonstrate comparable outcomes.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Gather and analyze requirements, conduct gap assessments, review VisionPLUS functionality, and prepare BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Participate in meetings with business stakeholders, development teams, testing teams, and delivery participants to clarify requirements, review solutions, and manage dependencies.
* Coordinate UAT activities, support defect triage and retesting, validate delivered changes, and contribute to enhancement, integration, upgrade, and production support deliverables.
* Make functional recommendations within agreed scope and standards, document decisions and risks, and escalate issues that may affect quality, timelines, system behavior, or business outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analysis, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in business analysis, including hands-on VisionPLUS experience and work in the cards and payments domain.
* Relevant training in VisionPLUS, business analysis, requirements engineering, SQL, Agile delivery, testing, or payment systems is preferred.
* Certifications in business analysis, Agile delivery, payments, or related technology areas are preferred but not required unless mandated for a specific assignment.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through relevant training, product updates, industry learning, and evolving cards, payments, and technology practices.

**CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :**
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
  
  
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organization's ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
  
  
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
  
  
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
  
  
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Drafting regulatory policies for AIFs, Mutual Funds, Wealth Management Firms
* Doing process documentation, review, transformation
* Worked on large scale transformation programs
* Project Management
* Working on AI initiatives etc,

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* CA/MBA/ CFA

**Experience**

* Worked on process documentation / project management tools
* Experience of working on AI tools
* Advance excel and powerpoint
* Experience of 3-5 years of experience in WAM practice

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
  
  
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
  
  
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

**Solution Ownership and Commercial Growth**

* Minimum 10-12 years’ experience in Market Research

* Has knowledge of research techniques and methodologies

* Has strong analytical skills and business commercial acumen

* English level: advanced oral and written

* High Negotiation, Problem Solving & Communications Skills

* Teamwork: Ability to work with others on tasks and activities without necessarily being the leader

* Influence skills, good level of relationship / networking, internal and external

* Volunteer time off

title: Sales Analytics Senior Analyst - AVP - MUMBAI
description:
**Role Overview**
Citi is seeking an Assistant Vice President within the Sales Analytics team to support the development and delivery of sales performance metrics, client analytics, and management reporting across Markets. Working closely with senior stakeholders and the broader analytics team, the successful candidate will help transform complex data into actionable business insights that support strategic decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of data, finance, and business strategy, offering exposure to senior Markets leadership and the opportunity to contribute to key franchise-wide initiatives. The individual will play an important role in delivering recurring analytics, developing reporting methodologies, and supporting the evolution of self-service analytics capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Produce and maintain recurring sales productivity reporting and performance metrics for Markets businesses, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
* Support the development and enhancement of Client Value (CV), Wallet, and sales performance methodologies across products and regions.
* Analyze client, sales, and commercial performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention.
* Consolidate and transform client feedback data from multiple sources, including relationship manager interactions, call reports, and client management systems.
* Create and maintain senior management reporting materials, including client profiles, business reviews, and performance scorecards.
* Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, COO, Client Analytics, and Technology teams to source, validate, and reconcile data.
* Develop compelling visualizations and dashboards that communicate business performance clearly and effectively.
* Support automation and process improvement initiatives to reduce manual reporting activities and improve data accessibility.
* Contribute to the development of self-service reporting and AI-enabled analytics tools.
* Ensure strong governance, documentation, and quality control across analytical outputs.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
* Relevant experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, finance, sales analytics, or management reporting within financial services or a corporate environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and generate actionable insights.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience using data visualization and analytics tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, Python, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.
* Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Markets, Institutional Banking, Capital Markets, or other financial services businesses.
* Exposure to client analytics, sales productivity measurement, wallet analysis, or commercial performance reporting.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms and client feedback data sources.
* Experience building dashboards, automated reporting solutions, or self-service analytics tools.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted analytics capabilities and their application in business reporting.
* Understanding of benchmarking or third-party market intelligence datasets.

**Success in the Role**
The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Deliver reliable and insightful analytics that support management decision-making.
* Build strong partnerships across business and functional teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes and analytical methodologies.
* Identify commercial opportunities through thoughtful analysis of client and sales performance data.
* Contribute to the team's broader goal of creating scalable, self-service analytics capabilities.

title: Senior Customer Success Data Analyst
description:
**Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes.**

**What should you know about us?**

Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit www.seclore.com.

**You would love our tribe:**

If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you!

**A sneak peek into the role:**

The Senior Customer Success Data Analyst owns how Customer Success uses data to improve adoption, retention, drive expansion and decide where CSMs focus.

You will own the CS analytics strategy, metric framework, customer health score and churn-prediction approach, and act as the analytics partner to the Head of CS Operations and CS leadership. As the team is new, you will design how data from various platforms, databases and raw Excel dumps in Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk and product telemetry comes together, and set the standard for how we use analytics and AI across Customer Success.

**Here's what you will get to explore:**

**CS analytics strategy**

* Own the CS analytics roadmap with the Head of CS Operations, prioritizing work by impact on retention and growth.
* Act as the trusted analytics partner to CS leadership, shaping decisions on segmentation, coverage models and customer playbooks.
* Present insights to CS leadership and contribute to board-level reporting.

**Customer health and churn prediction**

* Own the customer health score methodology end to end — design, validation against actual renewal and churn outcomes, and regular recalibration.
* Build predictive churn and propensity models (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis) and turn them into early-warning signals CSMs can act on.
* Compare retention and outcomes across customer groups (industry, region, account segments, products, sign-up period) to uncover what drives churn and growth.
* Lead root-cause analysis of churn and downsell.

**Metrics, dashboards and reporting**

* Define and govern the CS metric framework and a single source of truth so CS, Sales, Finance and Product report the same numbers and details.
* Own reporting on core CS KRAs — Gross and Net Revenue Retention (GRR/NRR), other renewal and growth details, time-to-value, adoption and health distribution.
* Oversee dashboards in Excel, presentations and Power BI for CS leadership and CSMs.
* Lead data and meeting preparation for internal monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and leadership/board reporting.

**Product usage, renewals and expansion**

* Partner with Product and Engineering to model product telemetry for adoption and value-realization metrics.
* Own risk-weighted renewal forecasting, so leadership sees a realistic outlook and CSMs know which renewals need attention.
* Analyze feature adoption, usage depth and breadth, and onboarding milestones to identify at-risk and high-potential accounts.
* Build models that identify upsell and cross-sell signals from usage, license utilization, account health and intelligence, and share them with CSMs.
* Measure the impact of CS programs and plays on retention and expansion revenue.

**Data foundations**

* Set data-quality and governance standards for CRM and CS-platform data, and drive fixes with system owners
* Design the CS data model and integrations across Salesforce, Statisfy, Freshdesk, internal deployment tools and product data.
* Document metrics, data sources and processes so analytics can scale with the team.

**AI-enabled analytics**

* Use LLMs such as Claude hands-on to accelerate building modules, analysis of data, querying data, documentation and insight generation.
* Design and roll out AI-assisted workflows and agents for CS — e.g. account summaries, sentiment analysis, renewal-risk briefs etc.
* Set guidelines for responsible, secure use of AI with customer data, in line with Seclore's data-protection standards.

**Your first 90 days:**

First 30 days

* Understand our customers, products and CS motion; assess data sources across various tools like Salesforce, Statisfy, product telemetry etc.
* Deliver a gap assessment of data quality.
* Deliver a baseline view of retention and renewals.

By 60 days

* Get the CS metric definition and framework agreed across CS and Finance.
* Launch the first version of CS leadership dashboard.
* Present the health-score framework and churn-model design.

By 90 days

* Launch V1 of the health score.
* Deliver a risk-weighted renewal forecast framework to CSMs for regular use.
* Publish a prioritized CS analytics roadmap.

**How we will measure impact over time:**
Predictive accuracy of the health score and churn models, use of insights in leadership and CSM decisions, data-quality improvements in CRM/CS platforms, and measurable contribution to GRR, NRR and adoption.

**What you bring**

* 5–7 years of experience in data analytics, with at least 2–3 years in customer success, revenue or business operations analytics, preferably in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related quantitative field; a master's degree is a plus.
* Proven track record of building customer health scores or churn models end to end and getting them adopted by CS teams.
* Advanced SQL and strong Python for data wrangling, statistical analysis and predictive modeling (e.g. logistic regression, survival analysis).
* Expert-level dashboard building in Power BI and Excel.
* Deep experience with Salesforce (or a similar CRM) data — accounts, opportunities, renewals.
* Hands-on experience administering or configuring a customer success platform such as Statisfy, Gainsight, Totango or ChurnZero.
* Experience designing data models and working with data from multiple systems and raw sources.
* Strong command of SaaS and subscription metrics: ARR, GRR, NRR, churn, renewal rate, adoption.
* Advanced, hands-on AI user with experience applying LLMs such as Claude to analysis, coding, automation and documentation.
* A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving decisions with data and clear storytelling.
* A builder mindset and comfort creating structure, standards and processes where none exist yet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in cybersecurity, data security or another enterprise B2B technology domain.
* Experience leading small analytics projects or teams.
* Experience helping build a CS Ops function from scratch.
* Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and ETL/ELT tools.
* Experience building AI agents or automated workflows for business teams.
* Exposure to customer segmentation and CS coverage-model design.

**Who you will work with:**

You will work closely with CSMs, Solution Consultants, Project Managers, Technical Consultants, and Sales to monitor account health, identify risks, generate renewal and expansion insights, support renewal forecasting, manage expansion pipelines, and maintain shared CRM data standards. You will partner with Product and Engineering to leverage usage telemetry, drive adoption insights, and establish product feedback loops. You will also collaborate with Finance and Leadership on ARR, GRR, NRR, and retention reporting for business and board reviews.

**Why join us**

* Be the senior analytics voice in a new CS Operations team and shape how Customer Success uses data.
* High visibility, with direct exposure to CS, Sales, Product and Finance leadership decisions.
* Work on meaningful problems for global enterprise customers in data security.
* Hands-on use of modern analytics and AI tools, with room to experiment.

**How to Apply**

1. Complete the Microsoft Form.
2. After submitting the form, continue and submit your application on LinkedIn.

title: Data Analyst
description:
* LOCATION :Mumbai, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Bangalore, India
* DATE : 13 Oct, 2026
* JOB TYPE :FULL TIME
* CTC :Competitive and aligned with industry standards

**About The Role**
MitKat Advisory is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Data Analyst who is responsible for managing end-to-end security data collection, governance, integration, and operational analytics across assigned service locations. The position centralizes and validates data streams from physical security systems, dashboards, and logbooks to build real-time automated visualizations, conduct predictive modeling, and track program costs. By identifying trends and operational vulnerabilities, the Data Analyst delivers actionable, data-driven insights to optimize tactical resources, improve response capabilities, and support executive decision-making.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Centralize, clean, and validate data streams at service locations from physical security systems, including Access Control, CCTV, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Incident Management Systems.
* Aggregate data from security service provider dashboards, logbooks, registers, and digital feeds.
* Conduct operational data collection as required by Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compile security operational reports.
* Establish data hygiene processes to guarantee security data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with corporate privacy standards.
* Design, build, and maintain real-time automated operational dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) across Critical Incident Response Team (CIRT) deployments, equipment readiness, and incident response times.
* Produce monthly, quarterly, and annual security operational reports analyzing security trends, site-level risks, and resource utilization across locations.
* Perform variance analysis comparing actual deployments and equipment costs against maximum Statement of Work (Scope of Services) caps and monthly baseline targets.
* Analyze physical security incidents, unauthorized access attempts, and asset loss logs to identify emerging security trends and operational vulnerabilities.
* Deliver data-driven recommendations for optimal CIRT operator headcount, hardware, and tactical gear allocation across regions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications (Preferred): Professional certifications in BI tools (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, Tableau Desktop Specialist) or data management.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Practical experience in data aggregation, data hygiene, governance, and statistical analysis.
* Experience designing and maintaining interactive dashboards using industry-standard visualization platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker).
* Hands-on experience performing financial variance analysis, cost tracking, and operational metric modeling.
* Experience handling operational data streams, incident log analysis, or physical security metrics
* Strong knowledge of data governance principles, data hygiene practices, and corporate privacy compliance standards.
* Familiarity with predictive modeling techniques, trend analysis, and pattern identification methodologies.
* Understanding of operational performance metrics, resource utilization analysis, and budget variance tracking.
* Basic understanding of physical security technology systems (Access Control, CCTV, IDS, and Incident Management Systems).
* Data Visualization & BI: Advanced proficiency in building real-time dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
* Data Cleansing & Governance: Capability to integrate, validate, and sanitize disparate physical and digital data logs.
* Financial & Cost Analytics: Proficiency in performing cost variance analysis against baseline targets and Scope of Services budget caps.
* Technical Writing & Reporting: Ability to draft clear, error-free operational reports summarizing trends and strategic recommendations.
* Analytical Thinking: Translates raw, multi-source data into structured, predictive insights and actionable operational strategies.
* Data Integrity & Precision: High attention to detail ensuring complete accuracy, hygiene, and confidentiality across all reports and dashboards.
* Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies operational vulnerabilities, process enhancements, and system optimization opportunities.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Communicates complex analytics effectively to support operational leaders and vendor management teams.

Why Join Us?
  
  
At MitKat Advisory, you will work on high-impact geopolitical and strategic intelligence projects supporting global decision-makers. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to executive-level strategy while working within a dynamic and growing advisory environment. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with their CV and a brief writing sample demonstrating strategic analytical capabilities.

title: Director, Analytics Engineering & AI
description:
**Role Summary**
Analytics Gateway, part of Pfizer's Global Commercial Analytics (GCA) organization, is the India-based Global Capability Center that delivers innovative, high-quality analytics solutions at scale to Pfizer's data-driven International Commercial Division (ICD). The Director, Analytics Engineering & AI leads Analytics Gateway’s Data Engineering and Business Intelligence/Data Visualization teams which consists of ~20 colleagues who, in addition to traditional Data Engineering and Data Visualization offerings, are increasingly focused on designing, building, and scaling AI-enabled analytics solutions. Reporting to the Mumbai-based lead of Analytics Gateway, the Director will oversee the execution and delivery of analytics solutions and will work with International Commercial Division stakeholders and Business Transformation and Chief Marketing Office teams to ensure Gateway’s technical capabilities continue to meet the business's evolving needs.
  
  

* Lead the ~20 colleagues that form the AI Engineering, Data Engineering, and Business Intelligence / Data Visualization teams within the Mumbai-based Analytics Gateway Global Capability Center supporting Pfizer's International Commercial Division. Manage 4–6 direct reports and oversee hiring, colleague development, and resource allocation across the team.
* Act as the AI Engineering lead, owning the design, build, deployment, and scaling of AI-enabled and agentic solutions for commercial use cases, from proof of concept to production.
* Serve as solution architect and design authority for the team, defining reference architectures, technical standards, and reusable patterns across data, AI, and BI solutions, and providing technical sign-off on solution designs.
* Lead the development of agentic AI solutions using Snowflake Cortex Agents, orchestrating across structured and unstructured commercial data to deliver conversational, self-service insight and automated workflows, with appropriate guardrails, access controls, and responsible AI practices.
* Establish and own MLOps / LLMOps practices, including model and agent versioning, CI/CD for AI, automated testing and evaluation, performance and cost monitoring, and lifecycle management to ensure solutions are reliable, compliant, and production-grade.
* Design and deliver strategic analytics solutions end to end, sourcing and curating data from diverse commercial data sources and applying established data engineering practices alongside emerging AI techniques.
* Own the evolution of the team's data foundation, from data curation, database modeling, and ETL pipeline development toward governed, observable, AI-ready data layers, driving data quality and permanent resolution of issues at the source.
* Deliver intuitive, AI-enabled decision-support and reporting tools that turn complex data into clear, actionable insight for commercial stakeholders, from country teams to global leadership.
* Guide the team's transition from traditional BI and data engineering skillsets toward AI engineering, agentic AI, and modern data engineering, including infrastructure standardization, automation, and CI/CD, supported by talent pipelines, training, and mentorship.
* Partner with Business Transformation & Technology, Data Science, and Insights & Strategy teams to align on foundational data assets, engineering and AI best practices, platform choices, and shared roadmaps supporting Commercial's AI and analytics agenda.
* Represent the team to GCA and ICD leadership, providing visibility into delivery, capability growth, and risk, and translating technical outcomes into clear business narratives.
* Contribute to documentation, playbooks, and knowledge-sharing practices, serving as a subject matter expert who raises AI and analytics capability across the organization.
* Drive a positive, inclusive, and high-engagement culture focused on retention, innovation, team development, and knowledge sharing.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 15-20 years of relevant experience in data analytics, data science, or business intelligence, and 8+ years’ people-management experience with demonstrated success leading managers.
* Proven track record of leading the design, development, and delivery of AI-enabled analytics and data engineering solutions that drive measurable business impact at scale.

**Education:**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Management, Applied Econometrics, Actuarial Science, Statistics, Data Mining, Machine Learning, Analytics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, or related field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated breadth of technical leadership experience, including engineering delivery, data architecture, ETL pipeline development (e.g., dbt, Airflow), database modeling, and BI/visualization tooling (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), together with fluency in data quality/observability monitoring (e.g., Grafana), agentic AI, and modern cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake)
* Strong ability to influence stakeholders to develop high‑performing teams by coaching direct-report workstream leads to deliver meaningful outcomes and sustained business impact.
* Hands-on experience architecting and delivering AI / agentic solutions on Snowflake Cortex (Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search) or similar platforms.
* Experience establishing MLOps / LLMOps practices, including model and agent deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and governance.
* Proven experience as a solution architect for enterprise-scale data and AI platforms.

title: Analytics & Insights Lead
description:
**\#\# The Opportunity** 




  





 At a fast\-growing company, data is rarely the hardest problem. The harder problem is understanding what the data is actually telling you.
 



  





 A business can have dashboards, reports, and hundreds of metrics, and still have five different explanations for why performance changed. One team sees a demand problem. Another sees an execution problem. Someone else sees a capacity issue. The founder looks at the same numbers and asks: "But what is actually going on?"
 



  





 This role exists to answer that question.
 



  





 We are looking for an exceptional analytical generalist who enjoys taking ambiguous business problems, going deep into data, testing competing hypotheses, finding the underlying pattern, and turning it into a clear insight that helps leadership make better decisions.
 



  





 You will work closely with the Founder \& CEO and senior leadership, across functions and business problems.
 



  





 This is deliberately not a conventional reporting or BI role.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What You Will Do** 




  





 Your work will typically move through: Business Question \> Data \> Analysis \> Insight \> Decision \> Outcome.
 



  





 You may start with something as simple as: "Why has this metric changed?"
 



  





 But the real work is figuring out: What actually changed? Where did it change? Is the movement real? What could explain it? Which explanations are supported by evidence? What don't we know? What should we investigate next? What does this mean for the business?
 



  





 You will work across areas including growth, customers, operations, finance, productivity, unit economics, and strategy. The specific questions will change constantly. That is part of the role.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What Makes This Role Unusual** 




  





 You will not be handed a neatly defined analytical problem every morning. Some of the most valuable questions will arrive as:
 



  





 "Something feels wrong with this number."
 



  





 "Three teams have three different explanations. Which one is right?"
 



  





 "We're growing, but I'm not sure we're getting better."
 



  





 Your job will be to turn that ambiguity into a structured investigation. Sometimes you will discover that the original question was wrong. Sometimes the answer will contradict a senior stakeholder's belief. Sometimes the data will not be good enough to answer the question conclusively.
 



  





 Knowing the difference between Fact, Inference, Hypothesis, and Unknown will be an important part of the job.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# Your Core Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. \*\*Solve ambiguous business problems.\*\* Take loosely defined questions and structure them into analytical problems that can actually be investigated.
 



  





 2\. \*\*Diagnose performance.\*\* Identify the underlying drivers behind important business movements rather than simply reporting the movement.
 



  





 3\. \*\*Generate insights.\*\* Find patterns, relationships, exceptions, and opportunities that are not obvious from standard reporting.
 



  





 4\. \*\*Challenge assumptions.\*\* Test prevailing explanations rather than accepting the first plausible narrative, including your own.
 



  





 5\. \*\*Create a common fact base.\*\* Help leadership distinguish between what we know, what we believe, and what we still need to find out.
 



  





 6\. \*\*Translate analysis into business language.\*\* Turn complex analysis into concise conclusions that senior leaders can understand and act upon.
 



  





 7\. \*\*Support important decisions.\*\* As you build context and credibility, increasingly contribute to recommendations, experiments, and decision\-making.
 



  





 8\. \*\*Build analytical systems.\*\* Develop reusable frameworks and diagnostic approaches so the organisation becomes progressively less dependent on individual intuition.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What We Are Looking For** 




  





 We care much more about how you think than what your previous job title was.
 



  





 You could come from Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, Business Intelligence, Growth, Product, Marketing Analytics, Operations, Revenue Management, Corporate Strategy, Finance, Founder or Chief of Staff roles, or other analytically intensive functions.
 



  





 You could have worked in Consumer, Technology, SaaS, E\-commerce, Q\-commerce, Fintech, Edtech, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Consulting, or something completely different.
 



  





 Industry experience is not a prerequisite. If you are a strong analytical thinker, we expect you to learn a new business.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# The Capabilities That Matter Most** 




  





 \*\*Analytical reasoning.\*\* You can take a messy problem, break it down, and determine what needs to be understood.
 



  





 \*\*Data fluency.\*\* You are comfortable working directly with data and can independently investigate a problem using tools such as Excel/Sheets, SQL, BI tools, or equivalent. You do not need to be a data engineer. You do need to be able to go behind a dashboard when the question requires it.
 



  





 \*\*Business judgment.\*\* You understand that analysis is valuable only when it improves understanding or decisions. You naturally ask: "So what?"
 



  





 \*\*Intellectual independence.\*\* You are willing to challenge an attractive explanation when the evidence does not support it.
 



  





 \*\*Intellectual honesty.\*\* You are comfortable saying "I don't know yet" and equally comfortable saying "I was wrong."
 



  





 \*\*Communication.\*\* You can take something complicated and explain it simply.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What This Role Is NOT** 




  





 This is not primarily a MIS role, reporting role, dashboard\-building role, Tableau administration role, data engineering role, or data\-entry role. We are not looking for someone whose main contribution is producing more reports.
 



  





 If your proudest accomplishment is "I built 30 dashboards," this may not be the right fit.
 



  





 If your proudest accomplishment is "I discovered why a major business metric was deteriorating, changed management's understanding of the problem, and influenced the intervention," we want to meet you.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# Tools** 




  





 You should be comfortable with analytical tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, SQL or equivalent, and Tableau/Power BI/Looker or similar BI platforms. Python, statistics, and experimentation capabilities are useful additions.
 



  





 But we will not hire you because you know a particular tool. Tools can be learned. Analytical judgment is harder to teach.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# Experience** 




  





 Typically 5 to 10 years of relevant experience. But we are deliberately not making years, title, or industry rigid filters. If you have spent fewer years solving unusually difficult analytical problems, we would rather hear from you than automatically reject you. Likewise, ten years of reporting experience is not necessarily more relevant than five years of genuine business analytics.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# What Success Looks Like** 




  





 \*\*First 90 days.\*\* You understand the business, data ecosystem, and major economic drivers. You independently solve several high\-value analytical problems and establish credibility with senior leadership.
 



  





 \*\*Six months.\*\* Leadership begins coming to you not merely for numbers, but for: "Help me understand what's happening here." You proactively surface important exceptions, patterns, and insights.
 



  





 \*\*Twelve months.\*\* You have helped create a repeatable organisational capability for moving from Data \> Analysis \> Insight \> Decision, and reduced the analytical heavy lifting that currently sits with founders and functional leaders.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# Why This Could Be an Unusually Good Career Opportunity** 




  





 This role sits close to the Founder \& CEO and senior leadership team. You will see how a rapidly scaling company actually works: how strategic decisions get made, how growth and profitability trade off, how functions interact, how capital gets allocated, how operational constraints emerge, and what happens after the decision is made.
 



  





 The environment will not always be neat. There will be ambiguity, incomplete data, strong opinions, and problems nobody has solved before.
 



  





 For the right person, this role can become a bridge from being an analyst of the business to becoming someone who helps shape the business.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# How We Will Evaluate You** 




  





 We will not select primarily on pedigree, certifications, or familiarity with our industry.
 



  





 Our process is designed to understand: Can you think? Have you demonstrated that thinking in the real world? Can you apply it to unfamiliar business problems? Can you communicate it clearly to senior leaders?
 



  





 The process includes an analytical thinking assessment, a practical business case, and a deeper conversation about problems you have personally solved in your career.
 



  





 \-\-\-
 



  





**\#\# The Person We Are Looking For** 




  





 You may be a data analyst who has become increasingly interested in the business behind the numbers. You may be a consultant who wants to move from advising companies to being inside the problem. You may be a strategy professional who wants to become more analytically rigorous. You may be a product, growth, or operations professional who has discovered that your strongest skill is figuring out why things happen. Or you may have an unconventional background entirely.
 



  





 The common thread is: you are unusually curious about how things work. You do not stop at "What happened?" You want to know "Why?" And then "So what?" And eventually "What should we do about it?"
 



  





 \*\*If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.\*\*
 



  





**Only Mumbai based candidates apply.**

title: Growth Manager
description:
**Position:  Growth Manager** 




**Function: Growth / D2C / Marketing (Retention\+ CRM\+ P\&L)** 




**Industry Preference: D2C, FMCG, Nutrition, Wellness, Beauty, Personal Care, Lifestyle** 




**Location: Mumbai** 




**Experience: 7–10 years** 




**Reporting To: Director** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a commercially driven Growth \& Retention leader who can own the complete D2C growth charter with a strong focus on revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, retention, repeat purchases and P\&L management.
 



 The role will be responsible for building and scaling the D2C business by combining performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer segmentation, loyalty, CRO, analytics and commercial decision\-making.
 



 The ideal candidate should have experience working with a consumer\-facing brand, preferably within D2C, FMCG, nutrition, wellness, beauty, personal care or lifestyle, and should be comfortable operating at the intersection of growth, marketing, technology, analytics and business P\&L.
 



  





**1\. D2C Growth \& P\&L Ownership** 




 ·       Own the overall D2C revenue and P\&L, including revenue growth, gross margins, contribution margins, CAC, LTV and profitability.
 



 ·       Develop and execute annual and quarterly D2C growth strategy aligned with business objectives.
 



 ·       Identify opportunities to improve revenue, profitability, customer value and channel efficiency.
 



 ·       Own monthly growth targets and develop actionable plans to achieve them.
 



 ·       Monitor Revenue, AOV, CAC, LTV, ROAS, repeat rate, retention and contribution margin.
 



 ·       Drive data\-led decisions on marketing investments, product mix, promotions and customer segments.
 



  





**2\. Customer Acquisition \& Performance Marketing** 




 ·       Lead performance marketing across Meta, Google and other relevant acquisition channels.
 



 ·       Scale acquisition while maintaining a healthy CAC\-to\-LTV ratio.
 



 ·       Work with performance marketing teams/agencies to optimise campaign performance.
 



 ·       Develop strategies for customer acquisition and efficient media spends.
 



 ·       Diversify acquisition through organic, partnerships, SEO/AEO/GEO, referral and other growth channels.
 



 ·       Establish clear attribution and measurement frameworks.
 



  





**3\. Retention \& CRM** 




 ·       Own the complete customer retention and lifecycle marketing charter.
 



 ·       Increase repeat purchases, customer frequency, retention and LTV.
 



 ·       Develop lifecycle journeys for new, repeat, dormant, high\-value and churn\-risk customers.
 



 ·       Drive CRM through Email, WhatsApp, SMS, push and other relevant channels.
 



 ·       Build journeys covering onboarding, first\-to\-second purchase, replenishment, cross\-sell/upsell, win\-back, loyalty and VIP customers.
 



 ·       Use RFM, cohort and behavioural segmentation to personalise communication.
 



 ·       Track cohort\-level retention and identify opportunities to improve LTV.
 



  





**4\. Loyalty \& Monetisation** 




 ·       Build and scale loyalty, rewards, referral and membership programs.
 



 ·       Increase customer frequency and basket size.
 



 ·       Develop monetisation strategies that improve customer value without negatively impacting contribution margins.
 



 ·       Analyse loyalty adoption, repeat behaviour and profitability.
 



  





**5\. Growth Analytics \& Optimisation** 




 ·       Establish a growth dashboard covering the customer funnel.
 



 ·       Analyse cohorts, acquisition sources, retention curves and LTV.
 



 ·       Conduct A/B testing and CRO across website, landing pages, product pages, checkout and customer journeys.
 



 ·       Identify funnel drop\-offs and work with Product/Tech to improve conversion.
 



 ·       Build forecasting models for revenue, acquisition, retention and marketing spends.
 



 ·       Translate data into business recommendations for leadership.
 



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Leadership** 




 ·       Work closely with Brand, Product, Creative, Technology, Analytics, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations.
 



 ·       Align growth initiatives with inventory, launches, pricing and promotional calendars.
 



 ·       Partner with Finance to track P\&L, contribution margins and marketing ROI.
 



 ·       Work with Product and Tech to improve D2C customer experience and conversion.
 



 ·       Lead internal teams and external agencies/vendors across growth, CRM, performance and partnerships.
 



  





**7\. Organic \& Emerging Growth Channels** 




 ·       Explore emerging acquisition channels beyond traditional paid media.
 



 ·       Develop SEO, AEO and GEO strategies to increase organic discovery and reduce dependence on paid acquisition.
 



 ·       Track traffic, conversion and revenue from organic and emerging search surfaces.
 



 ·       Identify new digital platforms, partnerships and consumer touchpoints contributing to D2C growth.
 



  





**Key KPIs** 




 ·       D2C Revenue Growth
 



 ·       P\&L / Contribution Margin
 



 ·       Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
 



 ·       Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
 



 ·       LTV:CAC
 



 ·       Repeat Purchase Rate
 



 ·       Customer Retention
 



 ·       Revenue from Existing Customers
 



 ·       New Customer Acquisition
 



 ·       AOV
 



 ·       Purchase Frequency
 



 ·       ROAS / Marketing Efficiency
 



 ·       CRM Revenue Contribution
 



 ·       Conversion Rate
 



 ·       Cohort Retention
 



 ·       Loyalty Program Adoption \& Revenue
 



 ·       Organic Revenue Contribution
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 ·       7–10 years of experience in Growth, D2C, CRM, Retention, Performance Marketing or related consumer businesses.
 



 ·       Owned or significantly contributed to a D2C P\&L.
 



 ·       Hands\-on experience in customer retention and lifecycle marketing.
 



 ·       Experience managing performance marketing budgets and understanding CAC and ROAS optimisation.
 



 ·       Strong understanding of LTV, cohorts, RFM, retention and customer segmentation.
 



 ·       Experience building CRM automation and lifecycle journeys.
 



 ·       Strong commercial mindset and understanding of growth, revenue and profitability.
 



 ·       Comfortable working with data and making decisions based on analytics.
 



 ·       Experience managing cross\-functional teams and external agencies.
 



 ·       Able to operate in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment with high ownership.
 



  





**Preferred Industry Background** 




 D2C \| FMCG \| Nutrition \| Health \& Wellness \| Beauty \| Personal Care \| Food \& Beverage \| Lifestyle \| Consumer Internet \| E\-commerce
 



 Experience with a high\-frequency or repeat\-purchase consumer category would be an added advantage.
 



  





**Preferred Tools / Platforms** 




 Shopify \| CleverTap \| MoEngage \| WhatsApp Business API \| Meta Ads \| Google Ads \| GA4 \| Unicommerce \| Marketing Automation \& CRM Platforms
 



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 The person in this role will be expected to build a profitable and scalable D2C growth engine, where acquisition and retention work together—driving new customer growth while continuously increasing repeat revenue, LTV and contribution margins.
 



 This role is not a pure Performance Marketing or CRM role; it requires someone who can connect Growth \+ Retention \+ Analytics \+ Commercial/P\&L ownership into one business charter.
 



  





 Interested candidate can share their CV at
 **hr@aceblend.com**

title: Assistant Manager- Financial Reporting- Mumbai
description:
BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It’s a leading service provider for the mid\-markets with client service at its heart. BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory \& assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries.
 



  





 BDO India is led by more than 300\+ Partners \& Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3\-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi\-fold.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting Manager to take ownership of the financial reporting and month\-end close process across group entities. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, audit management capabilities, and a strong focus on internal controls and financial governance. The role will work closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Compliance, and senior leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Financial Reporting \& Month\-End Close
 



  





 Own and drive the monthly financial reporting and close process across group entities.
 



  





 Ensure timely and accurate closure of monthly books within defined timelines.
 



  





 Review trial balances, general ledger accounts, and supporting schedules.
 



  





 Review and ensure accurate accounting of provisions, accruals, prepayments, depreciation,
 



 amortization, and other month\-end entries.
 



  





 Perform detailed variance analysis of actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, and highlight key business drivers to management.
 



  





 Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data across entities.
 



  





 Financial Statements \& Accounting Compliance
 



  





 Prepare and review annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS / Local GAAP.
 



  





 Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions and financial reporting matters.
 



  





 Provide accurate financial information, schedules, and supporting documentation for regulatory and statutory filings.
 



  





 Partner with the Compliance and Secretarial teams to ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting.
 



  





 Statutory \& Internal Audit Management
 



  





 Lead and manage statutory audits across group entities.
 



  





 Coordinate and support internal audits, including preparation of audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents, and deliverables.
 



  





 Act as the key point of contact between auditors and internal stakeholders.
 



  





 Manage audit timelines and ensure timely closure of audit observations and queries.
 



  





 Proactively identify and resolve audit issues with minimal escalation.
 



  





 Internal Financial Controls \& Governance
 



  





 Execute and monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCR/IFC) within the reporting function.
 



  





 Ensure appropriate documentation and testing of key financial controls.
 



  





 Identify control gaps and drive timely remediation.
 



  





 Strengthen financial governance and control frameworks across entities.
 



  





 Ensure compliance with internal policies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.
 



 Lease Accounting \& Fixed Assets
 



  





 Manage lease accounting, including maintenance of lease trackers and periodic accounting entries.
 



  





 Ensure appropriate accounting and reporting under Ind AS 116, where applicable.
 



  





 Oversee fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, and reconciliation.
 



  





 Ensure accuracy and completeness of fixed asset registers and related schedules.
 



 Balance Sheet \& Month\-End Governance
 



  





 Ensure all balance sheet schedules are prepared, reviewed, and reconciled on a monthly basis.
 



  





 Maintain strong controls over provisions and expense recognition.
 



  





 Ensure appropriate cut\-off procedures and completeness of expense recognition.
 



  





 Investigate and resolve long\-outstanding reconciling items and unusual balances.
 



  





 Drive high standards of accuracy and financial discipline across the reporting process.
 



 Stakeholder Management
 



  





 Collaborate closely with Service Lines, FP\&A, AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, and other cross\-functional teams.
 



  





 Provide management with relevant financial information, analysis, and insights.
 



  





 Partner with stakeholders to resolve accounting, reporting, and close\-related issues.
 



  





 Build strong working relationships with senior stakeholders and external auditors.
 



 Process Improvement \& Systems
 



  





 Identify opportunities to improve and standardize financial reporting and close processes.
 



  





 Drive standardization of reconciliations, reporting schedules, and management reporting formats.
 



  





 Identify opportunities to strengthen controls and improve process efficiency.
 



  





 Support enhanced utilization and optimization of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.
 



  





 Drive process improvements, automation, and reporting efficiencies wherever relevant.
 



  





 Qualifications \& Experience
 



  





 Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory.
 



  





 3\+ years of post\-qualification experience in financial reporting, accounting, controllership, or related finance functions.
 



  





 Strong hands\-on experience in:
 



  





 Financial reporting and financial statements
 



  





 Month\-end and year\-end close
 



  





 Statutory and internal audits
 



  





 Balance sheet reconciliations
 



  





 Internal financial controls
 



  





 Technical accounting
 



  





 Experience managing reporting across multiple entities will be preferred.
 



  





 Experience in professional services, consulting, Big 4, or similar environments will be an advantage.
 



  





 Working knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle

description:
We’re Hiring \| Marine Loss Control \& Risk Engineering Specialist \| Mumbai
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Marine Loss Control \& Risk Engineering Specialist to strengthen our Marine Cargo Risk Management and Loss Prevention function.
   

 The position requires a professional with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in logistics, cargo handling, marine/transit risk management, loss prevention, root\-cause
   

 analysis and operational gap assessment.
   

  

 The role will focus on proactively identifying why cargo losses occur and how recurrence can be prevented.
   

  

 The specialist will undertake field\-level risk assessments and detailed root\-cause/gap analysis covering exposures such as wet damage, improper handling, shocks \& jolts, inadequate packaging, stowage and stacking failures, compression/load stresses, lashing and securing deficiencies, contamination, cargo characteristics and other logistics\-related causes of loss.
   

  

 A critical part of the role will involve analysing Claims MIS, historical loss trends, survey reports and operational data to identify recurring patterns and loss drivers, correlate field observations with claims experience, and translate the findings into practical and measurable Loss Prevention / Loss Control recommendations for insured clients.
   

  

 The specialist will also support Marine Underwriting by assessing complex or critical cargo exposures prior to risk acceptance, identifying potential loss scenarios and providing technically supported risk insights, warranties, safeguards and loss\-control recommendations to assist underwriting decisions.
   

  

 Preferred Professional Background: Master Mariner / Chief Officer / Second Engineer; or an experienced Engineer / Packaging Specialist with strong practical knowledge of logistics and cargo handling. Candidates from relevant marine, engineering, cargo risk or industrial packaging backgrounds may also be considered where they can demonstrate expertise in packaging design and adequacy, compression/load stresses, palletisation, stacking, stowage planning, lashing, securing and cargo\-handling risk assessment.
   

  

 The successful candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and investigative capability, field presence, technical judgment and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to convert complex observations and loss data into clear gap analyses and actionable recommendations.
   

 The position requires willingness to travel extensively for field risk inspections and client engagements, along with excellent technical report\-writing and presentation skills. Strong proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint is essential for claims analytics, trend analysis and management/client presentations.
   

  

 Location: Mumbai
   

 Level: Mid\-Senior
   

  

 Experience: Minimum 10 years relevant experience
   

  

 Function: Marine Cargo Risk Management \| Loss Control Engineering \| Loss Prevention \| Risk Engineering
   

 We are looking for a professional who can move beyond conventional inspection and reporting — someone capable of understanding what can go wrong, why losses are occurring, where the control gaps exist, and what engineering interventions can prevent the next loss.

**Job Title:** 
 Quantitative Analyst \- GMQR Prime Strategists
   

  

**Department** 
 : Global Markets Quantitative Research
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Prime Services leverages the banks experienced global team with in\-depth market knowledge to provide execution, clearing and financing solutions across asset classes to both Institutional and Hedge fund clients.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 Global Market Quantitative Research (GMQR) Team is responsible for most aspects of quantitative research within the Global Market universe, covering Interest Rates, FX, Credit, and Equity. There are teams in London, New York and Asia supporting trading activities of the flow and structured desks. They are responsible for the development of pricing, risk, margin, and profitability models and their implementation in the global analytics library.
   

  

 GMQR Prime Services is in charge of providing expert solutions to the Equity Prime Services suite of businesses for both trading / client facing activities and internal cost optimization. It covers modelling of rates, client analytics, stock loan automation/optimization, funding/resource optimization, inventory management and Delta One basket pricing. The teams develops sophisticated models and put in place the infrastructure and the technology to develop, support and optimize the activity and facilitate trading.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Within GMQR Prime Services, the role focuses on all areas of the Prime Service business – ranging from client pricing, stock loan automation / pricing, funding \& resource optimization, inventory management and Delta One pricing. This is a front office Associate quantitative research role.
   

  

* Participate in global research on various aspects of pricing of Cash PB, Synthetic TRS and Baskets
* Contribute to the design and development of Inventory Management tools.
* Development of a variety of models to estimate factors such as inventory depletion, short interest etc
* Support the legacy suite of applications (primarily python) and contribute to the design and build of both tactical and strategic future solutions.
* Understand legacy processes written in C\#
* Ability to understand technologies used for real time solutions: messaging queues etc and also the ability to build robust solutions which can communicate / interact with critical IT processes.
* Understanding of API design and performance enhancements
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
* Support the Stock Loan and Funding desks by performing advanced analysis on a daily basis.
* Take an active part in all front office activities by collaborating with other functions (Trading, Sales, IT and Market Risk) and Research globally and also develop relations with various stakeholders.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical skills and technical background in mathematics, computer science or finance.
* Strong and demonstratable prior programming experience in Python.

 BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial \& personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast\-growing business in Asia\-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.

description:
**Job Description:**
 This is an opportunity for an experienced Senior Risk Regulatory Reporting Analyst to play a pivotal role in ensuring Citi's compliance with Indian regulatory requirements, directly shaping the quality and integrity of credit risk data submitted to the Reserve Bank of India. Based within Citi's Risk Data Analytics, Reporting and Technology function, you will own end\-to\-end regulatory reporting processes across credit bureaus, working closely with senior leadership, business teams, and oversight functions to deliver accurate, timely, and audit\-ready submissions. Your work will directly influence Citi's regulatory standing in India and the reliability of data used for portfolio monitoring and strategic decision\-making.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the preparation and submission of credit risk regulatory reports to the Reserve Bank of India, ensuring all returns meet accuracy and timeliness requirements.
* Oversee the submission of credit data to four credit bureaus, monitoring data quality metrics and taking corrective action where rejection rates or quality index scores require improvement.
* Conduct root cause analysis on data rejected by credit bureaus and present findings and improvement plans to senior management to drive measurable gains in reporting quality.
* Coordinate fortnightly resubmission of rejected credit records across all bureaus, ensuring each cycle is completed within prescribed regulatory timelines.
* Monitor and resolve customer complaints and disputes received from credit bureaus and directly from customers, liaising with the internal ombudsman function and meeting regulatory resolution deadlines.
* Issue regulatory default notifications to affected customers following each fortnightly reporting cycle, in accordance with compliance obligations.
* Partner with business, risk, and technology teams to support the implementation of compliance frameworks and respond to audit, governance review, and regulatory inspection requirements.
* Provide business analysis input to risk data platforms and tools, contributing to solutions that improve reporting efficiency and meet ad hoc regulatory requests.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 10 or more years of experience in financial services, with direct exposure to risk regulatory reporting in the Indian banking context.
* Demonstrated ability to manage regulatory reporting obligations independently in a high\-volume environment where priorities shift frequently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with practical use of VBA for reporting automation or process efficiency.
* Clear and confident communicator at all levels, with the ability to present complex data quality findings and compliance updates to senior stakeholders.
* Track record of managing multiple concurrent regulatory deliverables without compromising accuracy or deadline adherence.


**Beneficial Skills \& Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with Credit Information Companies reporting, including bureau submission processes and data quality frameworks.
* Familiarity with programming concepts, automation tools, or risk data systems that support regulatory reporting workflows.
* Exposure to RBI onsite inspections, internal audit reviews, or credit risk governance frameworks within a banking environment.

 At Citi, you will work within a high\-performing regulatory reporting function that operates at the intersection of risk, technology, and compliance, giving you direct influence over decisions that matter at a franchise level. * A hybrid working arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you flexibility alongside meaningful in\-person collaboration.

* A performance\-driven environment where your analytical contribution to regulatory quality and compliance has a measurable impact on Citi's standing with regulators.
* Wellbeing and financial benefits aligned to your location, as part of Citi's broader commitment to supporting its people.

 Apply now to bring your regulatory reporting expertise to one of the world's leading financial institutions and take ownership of a critical compliance function within Citi India.
